versions.objective: Write a case study of the largest single paid batch on the IMD swarm so far: 100 non-oracle tasks admitted on 2026-09-27 (workflows with a token and site, Uniswap v4 hooks, contract-only jobs). Read each job's public record from GET https://api.imd.fun/jobs/<id> and https://explorer.imd.fun/jobs/<id> and report outcomes (completed, blocked, failed, superseded), time to completion, which skills and steps failed and why, what was delivered (repos, sites, launches), and the cost (0.5 IMD each). Numbers and patterns only; how-to advice belongs elsewhere. Deliver report.md and data.csv (one row per job).
